responsibility: This header declares edit_context, GCC's container for a transactional set of source edits derived from diagnostic fix-it hints. The interface lets clients add rich_location fixits, query validity, retrieve rewritten file contents, translate original columns to effective columns after prior edits, and generate or print diffs. It is the public API for fix-it application over one or more source files.
same_name_distinction: Defines the public edit_context interface and its high-level operations for adding fix-its, querying validity, rewriting content, and generating diffs. The .cc file contains the underlying edited_file/edited_line implementation and test coverage.
